name: Pipelines - Fabric Actions and Business Actions activities
description: The Fabric Actions activity enables users to invoke supported Microsoft Fabric REST API operations directly from Fabric Data Factory pipelines through a guided, low-code experience.The Business Actions activity enables users to invoke supported enterprise application operations through Azure Logic Apps connectors directly from Fabric Data Factory pipelines.

result.nameEs: Pipelines: actividades Fabric Actions y Business Actions
result.descriptionEs: La actividad Fabric Actions permite invocar operaciones de la API REST de Microsoft Fabric desde los pipelines de Data Factory con una experiencia guiada y de poco código. Business Actions permite invocar operaciones de aplicaciones empresariales mediante conectores de Azure Logic Apps.
